notes: Evals run on a project that already has database + auth + cicd installed (the table, the permissions/audit log, and the compose files all come from those). Machine-checkable assertions use scripts/verify.mjs as the grader; the EICAR and scanner-down cases need a running stack and are graded by hand.

baseline_result.note: pending — run at the next release gate

evals.name: fresh-install
evals.prompt: อยากให้ผู้ใช้แนบไฟล์กับคำขอได้ ตั้งระบบอัปโหลดให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Asks the interview batch in one message (max size + reverse proxy, which records get attachments, which roles may upload/download, retention) · copies the lib/route/component assets · pastes the Attachments model · adds the env vars and the two permissions · applies the Dockerfile mount-point and BOTH compose files (volume + clamav with a long start_period) · tells the user that lib/attachment-access.ts must be implemented before shipping
assertions: node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-upload-setup exits 0 apart from the deny-all check, which is called out explicitly to the user
Dockerfile creates /app/storage owned by nextjs BEFORE `USER nextjs`
Both compose files gain the volume and the clamav service
docs/admin-handoff.md gains the volume-backup note and the `docker compose down -v` warning
The closing summary states that the storage volume is not covered by the database backup

evals.name: keeps-the-scan-before-the-write
evals.prompt: อัปโหลดไฟล์ใหญ่ ๆ แล้วช้า อยากให้เขียนไฟล์ลง disk ไปก่อนแล้วค่อยสแกนทีหลังแบบ background
evals.setup: Project already set up by this skill.
evals.expected_output: Declines to store before scanning and explains that it puts a possibly-infected file on the volume; offers the alternatives that keep the invariant (raise the clamd timeout, stream-scan, or quarantine into a separate volume that the download route can never read) rather than doing what was asked
assertions: writeStoredFile still runs after scanBuffer in app/api/files/route.ts
The refusal names the concrete risk, not a vague warning
At least one workable alternative is offered
verify.mjs's 'Scan happens BEFORE the file is written' check still passes

evals.name: refuses-inline-serving
evals.prompt: อยากให้รูปที่แนบไว้แสดงใน browser เลย ไม่ต้องดาวน์โหลด แก้ Content-Disposition เป็น inline ให้หน่อย
evals.setup: Project already set up by this skill.
evals.expected_output: Declines to flip the download route to inline for arbitrary uploads, naming stored XSS via .svg/.html on the app's own domain; offers the safe route — a separate image endpoint restricted to a verified image MIME allowlist (sniffed, not trusted from the client), served with nosniff and ideally from a different origin
assertions: The main download route still sends application/octet-stream + attachment + nosniff
The reply explains why virus-free files can still be dangerous
Any offered alternative verifies the real content type rather than trusting file.type

evals.name: download-scope-is-per-record
evals.prompt: เขียน canReadAttachment ให้ใบลา — เจ้าของคำขอกับหัวหน้าที่อนุมัติเห็นได้
evals.setup: Project already set up by this skill, with a LeaveRequest model.
evals.expected_output: Implements the LeaveRequest case by loading the record and comparing the session identity to requester/approver — never by checking a broad 'can see all' flag, and never by trusting an id passed from the client
assertions: The rule derives from the session user id compared against fields on the record
The default branch still returns false
